<div class="row"><span class="cap">A measured rule fails when any repository's report fails it, and is stale when a repository it reaches has a stale report or none. Pattern, judged and written rules are stated: a report lists them and measures nothing.</span></div>
</div>

<div class="cols3">
<div class="card list">
<div class="lab">Checkers · what each one checks</div>
<div class="item"><div>budget<div class="cap">Words or bytes in the files, against a max</div></div><span class="num">7</span></div>
<div class="item"><div>version<div class="cap">Every pinned version is at least a minimum</div></div><span class="num">8</span></div>
<div class="item"><div>pattern<div class="cap">Text must not match a file of expressions</div></div><span class="num">7</span></div>
<div class="item"><div>judged<div class="cap">A model reads text against a rubric</div></div><span class="num">2</span></div>
<div class="item"><div>written<div class="cap">No checker; an audit judges the rule</div></div><span class="num">17</span></div>
</div>
<div class="card list">
<div class="lab">When an agent is shown a rule</div>
<div class="item"><div><span class="mono">start</span><div class="cap">At the start of each session</div></div><span class="num">6</span></div>
<div class="item"><div><span class="mono">edit</span><div class="cap">Before the first edit of a file it covers</div></div><span class="num">20</span></div>
<div class="item"><div><span class="mono">failing</span><div class="cap">Only while its check fails</div></div><span class="num">15</span></div>
</div>
<div class="card list">
<div class="lab">Kinds of rule</div>
<div class="item"><div>standing<div class="cap">Stays until someone changes it</div></div><span class="num">37</span></div>
<div class="item"><div>obligation<div class="cap">Work a landed change left owed. It is deleted once that work is committed.</div></div><span class="num">4</span></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="cap">Read from the newest report of each repository that <span class="mono">controls.toml</span> names. Each report is the output of <span class="mono">board rules check --json</span> in that repository's main run. Flightdeck stores nothing.</div>
</div>
